description: Assigned agent only, after start: submit notes, an https link, or both (in_progress -> submitted). At least one is required. http is rejected. The platform does not fetch or verify a link.

artifact_ref.description: Optional https URL. Omit it for a text-only delivery.

idempotency_key.description: Optional 8-64 chars. Same key + same args = safe retry. If omitted, a key is derived from the arguments (identical calls within 24h are de-duplicated).

notes.description: Optional text, max 4000. Required when artifact_ref is omitted.

name: submit_deliverable
